head: classical (handcrafted features only)
protocol: StratifiedKFold(shuffle, seed from configs/heads.yaml); scaler and classifier refit per fold; C fixed to the tune-selected value
why_not_deep_hybrid: The fine-tuned CNN was trained on the training split, so its features on any training fold are optimistic; cross-validating the deep or hybrid head there would overstate accuracy. Their uncertainty is reported with bootstrap intervals on the test predictions (reports/extra_test_<bundle>.json).
